name: Wild Antler FM
source:
Wild Antler FM is a furry visual novel about a forest ranger who, after burnout, decides to take a few days off in a small town. To his surprise, the moose meets a person he didn't expect to see.

[from [url=https://jaketigur.itch.io/wild-antler-fm]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
《Wild Antler FM》是一部毛茸茸的视觉小说，讲述了一位护林员在精疲力尽后决定在小镇休息几天的故事。令他惊讶的是，驼鹿遇到了一个他没想到会见到的人。

[来自[url=https://jaketigur.itch.io/wild-antler-fm]itch.io[/url]]
